asr.full_text: Love is often born out of coincidences and never chance. For instance, let's take a man and a woman preferably two competitors in business very demanding lawyers. Suppose they come to the little city of Niets. Although the city is obviously full of tourists. The town is, of course, full to tourists. We'll settle them in a small but very cozy hotel, in which, by the way, there only one room available. It's just so unusual. It does happen. The choice is difficult, one key for two, so let's make the morning pleasant. Bye. I live while love lives with me
